notes.title: Land Drifters - Welcome to 2025
notes.content:
[img]https://i.imgur.com/4kC5aN9.png[/img]

[h1]Welcome to the new year![/h1]

It's been awhile since the last update but we're still hard at work and making good progress and the game is coming out this year!

[h2]Sneak Peek[/h2]

Let's talk about crafting!

In Land Drifters, you can not only level your crafting skills, but there are also masteries with each skill. The more you work with iron, the better you get at it of course!

With this, each new area feels fresh again with new masteries to level up at a quick pace. 

[img]https://i.imgur.com/CDbrWm9.png[/img]

In this picture, you'll notice there is a smelting mastery, along with working with metals such as copper and iron. Crafting iron items will provide experience to blacksmithing (Red Bar) as well as to your iron mastery (Green Bar) at an accelerated rate.

If you ever get stuck trying to defeat the new enemies, no worries, as you hone your mastery, you can learn to make even higher quality gear to help you overcome them if needed!

[img]https://i.imgur.com/kASCz9Q.png[/img]

Each tier will have vastly improved stats over the previous ones if you get your mastery higher!

[img]https://i.imgur.com/KU205fd.gif[/img]
You can even click to give things a little more "oomph" if you're in a rush to try that new weapon.

[img]https://i.imgur.com/bZHmvzu.gif[/img]
The same with smelting.

There are many more crafting skills to explore and master!
